question: The mean and the variance of five observations are <math><mn>4</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5.20</mn></math>, respectively. Given mean =4

⇒3+4+4+x+y5=4⇒x+y=9     ...1

Given variance =5.2

⇒9+16+16+x2+y25-42=5.2

2xy=81-65⇒2xy=16⇒xy=8

∴ x-y2=x2+y2-2xy=65-16=49

∴ x-y=7
